method: Source model-name cleaning; means by model/benchmark/effort/budget; earliest registry prefix-matched release date; minimum cost reaching threshold among models released by date. Retrospective source prices, not a contemporaneous API price history. No fitted trend, interpolation of accuracy, or extrapolation.
reuse: Public chart contains 15 derived factual records with attribution. Raw third-party cost dataset and preparation code are not redistributed in this release; no licence claim is made for those raw files.
